# Copilot Instructions

The instructions for AI assistants in this repository are maintained in [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md) at the repository root. Read and follow it — including the rule to **ask for confirmation before generating or modifying `.md` files**.

For service code, also follow [docs/developer-guide/06-copilot-development-rules.md](../docs/developer-guide/06-copilot-development-rules.md). Principles and ADRs: [docs/architecture/00-principles-and-adrs.md](../docs/architecture/00-principles-and-adrs.md).
